# Synthflow AI

Synthflow AI provides AI-powered voice agents to automate both inbound and outbound calls, enhancing customer engagement and operational efficiency.

Category: Communication. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/synthflow-ai/.

## Actions

- **Create a new team**: Create a new team.
- **Create Assistant**: Create a new assistant.
- **Delete a team**: Delete an existing team.
- **Delete an assistant**: Delete an existing ai assistant.
- **Get AI assistant details**: Retrieve details of a specific ai assistant.
- **Get knowledge base**: Retrieve details of a specific knowledge base by its id.
- **Get phone numbers**: Retrieve a list of phone numbers associated with a workspace.
- **Get team details**: Retrieve details of a specific team by its id.
- **List AI assistants**: List all ai assistants associated with the account.
- **Update an existing team**: Update an existing team.
- **Update Assistant**: Update an existing assistant’s settings.
